marketing_wrapper: All 6: two-tone marketing wrapper (pink #f798d0 panel inside a teal #5baa94 border), all-caps black caption with mixed bold/regular words (top ~25%), and a black iPhone frame showing ~65-70% real UI, cropped at the bottom; 02 is tilted. The tab bar is cropped out of every frame.

typography.display: Custom geometric-grotesque at bold/black weight for screen and playlist titles ('Hot Hits Canada', 'Alex + Sam', 'Jump back in', 'Search'); Spotify's proprietary face (Spotify Mix / Circular lineage), not SF
typography.numerals: proportional; small grey times (18:51, -4:26) and save counts
typography.weights: black/heavy hero titles, bold section headers, regular track titles, regular grey secondary lines
typography.case_and_tracking: sentence/title case in-app, tight tracking on big titles; all-caps only on marketing captions

palette.accent_strategy: One owned green for play buttons, the selected filter chip, the currently-playing track title and the saved check; every other hue is extracted per content (mini player and audiobook cards tinted from cover art: red for 'Radio', maroon for 'The Perfect Marriage', navy for 'Neon Gods'; hero gradients from artwork).
palette.source: palette.json 03 (#121212, 25%), 04 (#111313, #151a1b); #f798d0 pink and #5baa94 teal are marketing wrapper; green and tile greys read visually; 05 #822a29 = artwork-tinted audiobook card

shape.radius_language: small-to-medium: ~4pt on album art and shortcut tiles, ~8pt on cards and the mini player, pill chips and Preview pill, circle play buttons
shape.borders_shadows: no borders; shortcut tiles are a lighter grey fill on black; no shadows
shape.materials: flat; artwork-coloured gradients fading into black behind headers

liquid_glass_visible: no: mini player is an opaque artwork-tinted bar; tab bar not visible
density: medium-high; 2x4 shortcut grid of 56pt tiles, 3-up shelves, list rows ~60pt with 48pt artwork
layout: Home: avatar + filter chips (All, Music, Podcasts, Audiobooks), 2-column recent shortcut grid, then horizontal shelves ('Jump back in'). Playlist: full-bleed hero artwork with huge title, curator, action row (thumb, add, download, more ... shuffle, big green play), track list. Search: white search field, coloured category tiles with tilted cover art.
navigation: Bottom tab bar is cropped out of every frame. Persistent mini player above it (artwork-tinted). Top: avatar button left, filter chips; screens use a floating round back button over hero art. Custom chrome throughout.
imagery_and_icons: Album, podcast and audiobook artwork dominate. Custom outline icon set (add-circle, download-circle, ellipsis, shuffle, connect-device, camera), white/grey; the play button is a filled green circle.
signature_visual_move: A #121212 stage where one owned green marks play and selection, and the mini player and cards take their colour from the current artwork.

direction_fit.primary: NEW: Dark Content Stage - near-black neutral stage, artwork-derived per-content colour, brand reduced to one owned accent on play/selection
direction_fit.secondary: Loud Owned Shell (marketing wrapper and the green only; the in-app shell is quiet)
direction_fit.why: The screens show the text record's Dark Content Stage exactly: neutral black stage, artwork-sampled tints on the mini player and cards, green only on play/selection, a custom heavy display face.

notes: Search category tiles with tilted cover art cut off at the corner are a recognisable Spotify move. The marketing wrapper's pink and teal are not in-app colours.
